title: Depth estimation and 3D reconstruction
reading: A visual-only slide illustrating the pipeline from a single street-scene photograph, through a predicted depth map, to a 3D point cloud of the scene. No body text appears beyond the title; yellow arrows carry the flow.

visuals.description: Top-left: RGB photo of a suburban street with parked cars (KITTI-style). A downward yellow arrow leads to a colour-coded depth map of the same scene (warm tones, near/far shading). A rightward yellow arrow leads to a large dark panel showing a white 3D point cloud of the street with scan-line structure.
visuals.assertion: Depth estimated from a single image can be back-projected into a 3D point-cloud reconstruction of the scene.

concepts.name: Depth estimation
concepts.why_it_matters: Produces per-pixel distance from an image, the input to 3D reconstruction.

concepts.name: 3D reconstruction / point cloud
concepts.why_it_matters: Geometric scene representation used in robotics and autonomous driving.
